label: workflow • a step that fails once is retried and the run completes
query: a step that fails once is retried and the run completes
notes: No model. A JavaScript code step throws on its first attempt (it leaves a marker file in the run workspace) and succeeds on the second; `retry.max_attempts: 2` makes the step end `done` and the run complete. Skips with a typed reason when osaurus-js-host is not reachable (set OSAURUS_JS_HOST_PATH).
